phase: initial (written before any command was executed; frozen)
overall_reason: The update introduces ConfChangeV2 / joint consensus (incoming+outgoing voter sets, LearnersNext, AutoLeave), Changer-based applyConfChange (demotion allowed, removal of unknown peer ignored, removing last voter rejected), raft-initiated auto-leave entries appended inside Advance, and RawNode/Node Ready/Advance refactoring. Most old properties stay as requirements but their observers/helpers (config record, Members, Won, ConfigOf, ConfKinds) must migrate to a joint representation, otherwise identical predicate text silently checks only the incoming majority. Semantic edits: EffectContract (demotion becomes required behaviour; raft-generated auto-leave entries are a legitimate id=0 origin), AckPreservation_LogUnchanged (impl-abstraction clause: Advance may now append exactly one auto-leave entry), ConfigurationTransitionSafety (joint voters; bootstrap exemption narrowed so auto-leave entries are checked), QuorumAccounting (joint majority). New obligations: one pending conf change also for raft-generated auto-leave entries, and quorum-overlap of every applied configuration transition. Several suspected implementation defects must stay visible (V2 entries not counted by numOfPendingConf; auto-leave not bumping pendingConfIndex; restore/newRaft ignore joint ConfState fields).

representation_basis.config_record: [voters |-> incoming (Voters[0]), outgoing |-> Voters[1], learners |-> Learners, learnersNext |-> LearnersNext, autoLeave |-> AutoLeave]

helpers.JointWon(c,yes): Won(c.voters,yes) /\ Won(c.outgoing,yes)  (quorum/joint.go VoteResult/CommittedIndex; empty majority wins by convention)
helpers.Members(r): AllVoters(r.config) \cup r.config.learners  (= DOMAIN prs; learnersNext \subseteq outgoing)
helpers.ConfKinds: {AddVoter,AddLearner,Remove,Update} \cup {"V2"}; V2 entries carry changes (seq of [kind,target]) and transition in {Auto,JointImplicit,JointExplicit}
helpers.ConfigAfter/ConfigOf: mirror confchange.Changer: LeaveJoint for empty V2; EnterJoint(autoLeave = transition#JointExplicit) when transition#Auto or >1 change; Simple otherwise; makeVoter/makeLearner(LearnersNext when target in outgoing)/remove(ignore unknown); invalid transitions leave cfg unchanged and are reported by ValidChange

suspected_defects: numOfPendingConf counts only EntryConfChange, not EntryConfChangeV2: a node with a committed but unapplied V2 change (enter-joint, leave-joint, auto-leave) may campaign (violates CampaignDecisionEligibility pending clause).

raft.advance appends the auto-leave entry without setting pendingConfIndex on success: a later Advance (applied index still >= pendingConfIndex, AutoLeave still true) appends a second auto-leave entry; applying it panics 'can't leave a non-joint config' (violates AutoLeaveOnePending, ConfigurationTransitionSafety, EffectContract, NoUnexpectedFatal).

raft.restore and newRaft rebuild the configuration from ConfState.Nodes and Learners only; NodesJoint, LearnersNext and AutoLeave are dropped, so a node restored/restarted in a joint config loses the outgoing majority (violates ConfigurationOrigin, and later LeaveJoint panics).

confchange.Simple returns (empty Config, empty ProgressMap, nil error) when checkInvariants fails after apply (error swallowed); probably unreachable because checkAndCopy validated the input, recorded only.
unresolved_obligations: Whether committed-but-invalid user ConfChangeV2 entries (e.g. enter-joint while joint, removing the last voter) should be prevented at proposal time or are a caller error: only impl/TODO evidence ('return the error to the caller'); NoUnexpectedFatal clauses for these new Changer panics stay unknown.

QuorumAccounting voters#{} clause stays unknown; new tests show the Changer refuses to create zero-voter configs, which removes reachable counterexamples but does not settle the empty-config election convention.
Liveness: the proto says Raft will leave the joint config automatically 'when this is safe'; no safety property forces the auto-leave to be proposed.
model_migrations_not_property_edits: ConfigAfter/ConfigOf/ApplyConfCore follow the Changer (joint, demotion, ignore unknown removal, Fatal on Changer errors).
AdvanceCore appends the auto-leave entry; quota reduction moves from Ready to Advance; RawNode msgs cleared at Advance.
RestartCore: RawNode no longer re-bootstraps (fresh branch removed); restore/restart lose joint fields (as implemented) to keep the defect observable.
Environment: RawNode not stepped between Ready and Advance.
